question: On one genuinely new HSC study, compare CAdir cell clustering with a standard PCA+SNN/Louvain workflow and describe CAdir geometry/gene outputs, without assuming superiority.

dataset.preferred_entry: scRNAseq legacy ExperimentHub resource path nestorowa-hsc/2.0.0
dataset.full_study_or_subset: Official legacy1920 candidate cohort; common objective QC determines final cohort; not original1656 reconstruction

blocking_conditions: Actual common QC and data/labels/evaluation locks
Independent design admission binding exact source/input/config/environment

shared_input.counts_requirement: finite nonnegative integer read counts; explicit unique gene/cell IDs
shared_input.metadata_alignment: exact gene/cell IDs, never positional or inferred ID prefixes

feature_classes.endogenous: remaining explicit gene IDs; no symbol deduplication or marker augmentation

QC.source: Verified raw counts; freeze inherited objective draft rule before applying to data
QC.zero_endogenous_counts: exclude with explicit technical reason; never use label availability
QC.rule: On positive endogenous libraries, pooled lower outlier log2(total) and log2(detected), or higher outlier unlogged ERCC percent, using median +/- 3 * stats::mad(constant=1.4826). Strict inequality; zero MAD keeps exact-median values.
QC.missing_ERCC: BLOCK and amend before any clustering; no silent substitute for a frozen metric
QC.batching: pooled rule, no donor-specific cutoffs or integration unless separately pre-amended and reviewed
QC.doublets: no automatic new doublet detector; report any source flags without label-driven deletion
QC.mitochondrial_QC: not applied without pinned gene annotation; ERCC/read-depth rules are the proposed QC, not claimed author QC
QC.zero_MAD: Strict one-sided cutoff at median if MAD=0: low side retains >=median; high side retains <=median; exact median retained.

normalization.size_factors: endogenous library size / mean(endogenous library size)
normalization.if_preexisting_logcounts: Verify source formula/provenance; STOP for amendment instead of silently normalizing twice
normalization.library_scope: All endogenous rows before low-expression gene filtering; mean computed across retained cells. This explicitly resolves draft ambiguity and avoids feature-filter-dependent size factors.
normalization.centering_note: Explicit library_size/mean already has mean=1; center.size.factors=FALSE prevents hidden second recentering. Formula remains log2(count/sf+1).

HVG.tie_rule: original raw gene-row order for exact variance ties

shared_input.minimum_conditions: Stop if <6000 eligible genes, <100 retained cells, selected-HVG zero row/column sum, or inability to supply 30 dimensions; no silent method-specific filtering.

CAdir.rationale: Predeclared transfer of the first-case k=8, 55 degrees, 30 dimensions and 6000 HVG. k is only initialization and is not selected from FACS classes; no HSC-specific optimization or superiority claim.
CAdir.ranking: Separate diagnostic process; reset each run seed, CAdir::rank_genes unchanged; record complete per-run results.
CAdir.annotation: not in primary experiment; no CellMarker/SingleR predictions used as reference

baseline.name: PCA + SNN + Louvain

SNN.d: NA (already PCA; do not reduce twice)

baseline.rationale: Standard logcount/HVG/PCA neighborhood workflow, infers cluster number without reference labels; no grid search, true-K input, label-informed resolution selection, UMAP or t-SNE clustering.

evaluation.candidate_source: author index-sort/FACS metadata; broad/narrow memberships can overlap
evaluation.exclusive_label_mapping: Use six published broad binary columns LTHSC_broad,LMPP_broad,MPP_broad,CMP_broad,MEP_broad,GMP_broad. Exactly one => suffix-stripped label; zero => missing; >1 => STOP. No narrow hierarchy, expression, FACS/DC values, or imputation.
evaluation.missing_or_conflicting_reference: remain in clustering if QC passes; excluded only from external metrics using a fixed mapping and explicit counts; no algorithm-dependent cohort
evaluation.NMI: MI / max(H_cluster,H_reference), natural-log entropies; one predicted cluster with multi-class reference -> 0
evaluation.insufficient_reference: If n_evaluated<2 or fewer than two reference classes, SKIPPED_INSUFFICIENT_REFERENCE; do not synthesize labels
evaluation.ARI_degenerate_denominator: record degeneracy; identical degenerate partitions=1, otherwise=0; primary multi-class reference condition usually avoids this
evaluation.summaries: All five predeclared seeds per method, individual values plus median/IQR/min/max among successes and explicit success denominator=5; no best-seed headline or significance claim from five seeds.
evaluation.compare_genes: CAdir geometry/assigned genes/ranks are descriptive; baseline does not supply a matched biclustering truth and no biological-validation metric is invented
evaluation.reference_scope: Immunophenotype reference, not biological truth; unknown donor/Rep; descriptive single study; no biological replicate inference.

per_run_artifacts: CA axis order and pivot signs
installed function/formals hashes and source commits
R3.ranking_equivalence: only fixed CA basis or explicitly verified alignment and replay; same seed alone does not guarantee basis-invariant ranking

resources.core_measurement: Fresh per-method/per-seed R process; wall time starts after package/shared-input load and spans CA+splitmerge (including built-in gene assignment) or PCA+SNN+Louvain; save outputs separately and report actual stage scopes.
resources.memory: sample /proc/PID RSS every 50ms during core; report stage peak plus process VmHWM sampled at core end (includes startup/input). No RAM performance claim from unmatched scopes.
resources.shared_preprocessing: one common preprocessing process, separately timed; exclude downloading/installing/common preprocessing from per-method core time
resources.diagnostics: CAdir ranking/plots in a separate untimed diagnostic process with its own resources; not hidden inside headline core comparison
resources.system_scope: record /sys/fs/cgroup cpu.max,memory.max; BLAS threads; R/package/function source signatures

failure_policy.retry: same frozen config and seed only for documented technical retry; never overwrite old attempt or replace a failed seed
failure_policy.parameter_changes: requires reason, new commit, independent review before evaluation; not tuning after metric inspection
failure_policy.timeouts_or_OOM: retain failure and denominator, no paid resource or memory escalation assumed

freeze_requirement: Only independent reviewer-authored admission binding exact commit and all manifest hashes can unlock formal runner. This file is not admission.
